verdict.rationale: The closest first-party evidence is that Sidekick can recommend stock transfers between locations and create them automatically, and that Quick counts let staff update stock quantities by barcode scanning. Both suggest multi-item inventory actions, but neither is documented as a general bulk-operations capability. GraphQL Admin API access from extensions is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit or bulk update of many items at once (prices, products, inventory) in POS, explicit multi-item scope for Sidekick actions, and hands-on corroboration.
